payload.title: Build bounded structured navigation and indexed task/decision search
payload.description: Add read-only tools for authoritative task requirements, live component ownership, changes since evidence and related task/decision retrieval. Use a derived incremental local search index and bounded results with explicit provenance and no automatic identity/completion decisions. Confirm model-comparison investigation remains open and link its published Markdown test design.
acceptance: Tools distinguish current requirements, document freshness, competing intent and verified prerequisites without asserting completion from plans.
Ownership includes live local worktree leases and overlapping scopes, never expired owners or implied cross-machine locks.
Changes identify added/modified/deleted scoped and linked source files, intent/check configuration changes and evidence freshness without full histories or secret content.
Indexed lexical and graph search supports Unicode, status/scope filters, paginated bounded hits and deterministic ordering; index rebuilds from Git-backed intent after loss or change.
Existing model alternatives task is open with its test-design document linked, without declaring candidates evaluated or trained.
